title: Indentation error in lambda function
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.6.stable, 4.5.1.stable

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS 24.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon 760M Graphics (radeonsi, phoenix, LLVM 20.1.2, DRM 3.57, 6.8.0-100-generic) - AMD Ryzen 5 7640U w/ Radeon 760M Graphics (12 threads) - 13.45 GiB memory

### Issue description

There were/are some problems with indentations in lamba functions but so far they just expected a diffent amount of indentations than they should. In this case, no amount seems to suffice. I've tried re-ordering it (starting with `InputMap` in the first line, continuing with `.map in the same line`) but to no avail.

There is no error if:
- `.map` is not chained, or
- `.map` is used in a different assignment

Edit: It seems to be specifically the `map` method, if you just change the order, the `map`'s return is still the problem.

To make such errors easier to debug in the future, I proposed to [print the expected indentation level in the error message](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/14185).

### Steps to reproduce

```gdscript
var _custom_input_map_actions: Array = (
		InputMap.get_actions()
			.filter(
				func(action: StringName) -> bool:
			return not action.begins_with('ui_')
			)
			.map(
				func(action: StringName) -> String:
					return action
			)
	)
```
